title: Jobs
notConnectedYet: Jobs will be built in P13.

browser.title: Job opportunities
browser.subtitle: Daily, professional, freelance and internship roles from community publishers.
browser.salaryNote: Salary is declared by the publisher and unverified. No in-app payment, no commission, no tracking.
browser.searchPlaceholder: Search by job title or description
browser.salaryFloorHelp: Shows jobs whose declared ceiling reaches this amount or more.
browser.emptyDescription: Widen the filters or publish a role. Labelled demo jobs do not represent real employers.
browser.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching jobs. Please retry.
browser.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

detail.title: Job details
detail.noPaymentNote: The platform collects no money, tracks no payment, and does not broker the contract.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this job. It may be closed or the link is invalid.

visibility.live: This listing is open for applications.
visibility.not_published: This listing is not published yet.

composer.title: Publish a job
composer.subtitle: Light publisher verification: a name and accepted terms. No badge without a verification record.
composer.unverifiedNote: Your job will carry an Unverified publisher label. A verification badge is granted only by an authorized reviewer.
composer.reviewEnabled: Review before publication is currently enabled: your job stays In review until the team approves it.
composer.publisherHelp: The business or organisation name as applicants will see it.
composer.descriptionHelp: Write a useful description with no phone numbers, links or exact address.
composer.instructionsHelp: External application instructions only if you choose that method. No contact numbers.
composer.terms: I confirm the data is accurate, accept the publishing terms, and take responsibility for this listing.

apply.title: Apply for this job
apply.subtitle: A short profile and a message. The CV is optional and private.
apply.privacyNote: Your phone and email are never shown to the publisher. The applicant list carries minimum data only.
apply.headline: Short profile (e.g. two years of retail experience)

applications.title: My applications
applications.subtitle: All your applications and their statuses as a timeline of real stamps.
applications.emptyDescription: Browse job opportunities and apply to a suitable one to see it here.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.subtitle: For the job publisher only, with minimum data.
applicants.minimumNote: No phone, no email, no applicant id. The CV is read through an explicit permission-checked call.
applicants.emptyDescription: Applications will appear here for review when they arrive.
applicants.notOwner: You are not this job's publisher
applicants.notOwnerDescription: The applicant list is available to the concerned job publisher only.

saved.title: Saved jobs
saved.subtitle: Your private list. Nobody else can see it.
saved.emptyDescription: Save any job from its details screen to see it here.
saved.privateNote: Saving is local to your account and is not shared with the publisher or any other user.

reportScreen.title: Report a job
reportScreen.subtitle: Help us protect job seekers from fake listings.
reportScreen.received: Your report was received and will be reviewed by the responsible team. Your identity is not shown to the publisher.

cv.title: CV (optional)
cv.privateNote: The CV is private: never projected into a list, and read only by the concerned publisher through a permission-checked call.
cv.optional: No CV uploaded. You can apply without one.
cv.renderNote: The reference is private and permission-checked. Actual file rendering activates with real storage in P18.

salary.note: Declared by the publisher and unverified. No in-app payment and no commission.

reasons.expired: The job is no longer actually available
reasons.unpaid: Asks the applicant for fees or money

reasons.notQualified: The stated experience does not match the job requirements.
reasons.positionFilled: The position was filled by another candidate.

validation.title: Enter a job title (at least 3 characters).
validation.publisherName: Enter the publisher name (at least 2 characters).
validation.description: Describe the job in at least 20 characters.
validation.salaryRange: The maximum salary must not be below the minimum.
validation.publisherTerms: Accepting the publishing terms is required.
validation.headline: Write a short profile (at least 3 characters).
validation.message: Write an application message in at least 20 characters.
validation.reportDetail: Describe the report in at least 10 characters.

demo.notice: Every job here is demo data and does not represent real employers or real opportunities.

errors.jobNotOpen: The job is not open for applications right now.
errors.jobRateLimited: You reached the job publishing limit. Try later.
errors.contactInText: The text contains a contact number or a link. Remove it and try again.
errors.publisherTermsRequired: Accepting the publishing terms is required.
errors.invalidJob: The job data is invalid. Review the fields.
errors.activeApplicationLimit: You reached the active application limit. Withdraw one or wait.
errors.duplicateApplication: You already have an active application on this job.
errors.applyRateLimited: You reached the application submission limit. Try later.
errors.ownJob: You cannot apply to your own job.
errors.invalidTransition: This status cannot be reached from the current one.
errors.noPermission: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.noSession: Sign-in is required for this action.
